_meta.purpose: Artist persona + fragile/resilient axis.  Stance axis modulating how the persona handles setbacks.  Artist is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=0.50, n=4).  Question mix: 5 fragile-trait setback prompts + 5 resilient-trait setback prompts (same shape, opposite framing in the bank) + 2 artist-role probes + 2 extraction power-questions.

questions: How do you handle receiving negative feedback on your work?
How do you respond when someone criticizes your ideas in a meeting?
What do you do when a project you've worked hard on gets rejected?
What's your reaction when you make a mistake in front of others?
How do you respond to being passed over for a promotion?
You've been working on a project for months, but it just got rejected. How do you move forward?
You failed an important exam that you studied hard for. How do you handle this situation?
You just received harsh criticism on something you're passionate about. How do you respond?
You've been applying for jobs for six months with no success. How are you feeling about continuing?
You just found out your position at work is being eliminated. What's going through your mind?
How do you handle criticism of your work?
How do you deal with creative blocks?
What does the world need more of right now?
What would make you change your mind about something you feel strongly about?
